notes: balanceVersion 3 adds the 20-stamina save migration; the version does not distinguish every historical economic experiment.

V4 repricing has 50 historical one-hour trajectories. Historical V5 has two paired groups of eight policies and ten seeds, 160 one-hour trajectories total. The old-price endgame proof is not a current population completion-time estimate.
The completion audit continues the same endgame trajectory and is not an independent sample.
Instant management requires active play; it is not unattended automatic revenue.
Raw settled payouts and unclaimed active-player valuations are separate.
V3 full equipment rewrite supersedes V2 44-item and V4/V5 old-equipment economic outputs; new staged fixtures do not measure acquisition time.
V3 primary and offline saturation tests total 1,826,536 real shots excluding smoke/rechecks and from-zero journeys.
From-zero milestone time statistics exclude non-attainers; 19 of 32 no-equipment runs were right-censored at 24 hours, not counted as successful completions.

The November13 original-name/art reuse changed presentation only at economy5 prices. Economy6 later changed three high-tier access/price entries and two project schedules; selected recruitment remains unimplemented.

Economy6 preserves V3 save/effect schemas and recorded purchase costs. Historical 306/504-coupon data, preimplementation candidate evidence and the fresh production economy6 run are indexed separately.

Economy7 keeps economy6 equipment/project prices and training rewards, adds staged gym construction totaling510. totalWithProjects remains727; totalWithConstruction is1237. Existing gym levels are exempt from retroactive charges.

Correction prototypes A/B/C/build510/build665 are preserved separately from formal atomic construction charges. Negative afterAllPermanent denotes a funding shortfall, not completed buying. Completion continuation keeps milestones[8] as the first gym8 time and verifiedCompletionBalance as actual post-purchase cash.

The comprehensive V7 audit counts328 executed trajectories across15 scenarios; paired seeds, reproduced baselines and extended runs are not328 independent players. Raw sources and their merged file must not be counted twice.

From-zero total24h endgame results and exact24h after real full construction/completion are separate experiments. Both require continuous online instant management, not product auto-recommendation or casual daily income.

Template witnesses use synthetic gym8/max-project/test-currency/access-collection fixtures and real generated athletes, legal purchases, training, matching and recommendation.119 covered templates is reachability evidence, not a from-zero full-collection completion-time estimate.

The save writer now enforces the same20000000-character envelope limit as the reader before touching recoverable storage. This protects old copies; it does not solve browser quotas or unbounded alumni-history growth. The5MiB quota findings are simulated, not actual user-browser quota measurements.

Post-completion positive income and shallow-training coupon efficiency remain design findings. No new reward reduction, price change or paid recruitment was shipped in this audit; endgame consumption is the selected next development priority.

Economy8 ships optional36-coupon selected admission at gym6 plus a read-only collection goal. Construction prices, item effects and recommendation rewards are unchanged; free admission remains available.

Selected admission guarantees only two directional base stats46..48 before project additions, retains original values already>=46, and consumes the real recruit stream only after atomic admission checks. A paid path returns at most33, but free training can still yield unlimited positive cash.

The final1536-athlete controlled audit supersedes its8-seed midpoint probe. Two-seed one-hour free/mixed pressure results are exploratory, not human adoption or universal collection-rate evidence. The incomplete12h prearchive file is excluded from completed results.

Browser history now uses authoritative IndexedDB hot current+backup and complete cold records in one transaction, with localStorage startup mirrors. Recent hot alumni are capped at100; archive counts preserve lifetime progression. Memory-injected stores retain separately tested staged synchronous semantics.

History benchmark timings are Node24 plus fake-indexeddb memory fixtures and a simulated5MiB localStorage quota. The20000 case is archive-run capacity, not recovery of an old envelope rejected by the20M reader limit.

Economy9 changes actual gym8 recommendation payout to min(raw,max(0,500-currentCredits)). Gym1-7, raw cultivation/cooperation formulas, fame and item/project/construction prices are unchanged. Existing excess balances and sale proceeds are retained;500 is not a universal inventory cap.

recommendation remains the raw qualification/value formula; recommendationPayout is the current cash preview and settlement. Withheld credits are not a deferred claim. Shared pending-player previews must share one balance headroom rather than sum individual capped previews.

The16-seed frozen V8 cap500 prototype and2-seed formal V9 construction rerun overlap in seeds and are not18 independent players. Both have4 one-hour exploratory flows. Actual buying is incremental because total remaining goods may cost more than the500 line while each single permanent purchase costs at most62.

V9 goal guidance evaluates every base and specialist route before each is fully eligible; route ordering is a gap-based heuristic, not a minimum-shot or specific-template guarantee. Matcher and growth outcomes are unchanged.
This iteration addresses gameplay only. Storage-recovery and backup tooling work is deferred at the user request.

Economy10 replaces the former500 recommendation line with gym8 phase per-template rewards: first successful valid-template recommendation pays the normal theoretical amount, all later recommendations of that template pay1 total; null-template recommendations pay0 and are never registered.

Pre-gym8 recommendations and existing historical records do not consume the new phase first reward. Old saves without the optional postgameRecommendedTemplates list start empty; money and prior claims are not clawed back. New gyms get a fresh phase list. Successful storage commit is required to consume first eligibility.

Higher levels or cooperation do not supplement a previously consumed first reward. Theory, fame, growth and qualifications remain unchanged; actual recommendation, event, alumni and UI amounts are first/repeat-aware. No500 credit cap remains in current rules.

First-template prototype4 seeds and formal2 seeds overlap, and each has4 one-hour exploratory flows; not6 independent population samples. Phase firsts recorded during construction carry into later flows. Raw/actual and full evidence are kept separately.

Repeat rewards stay positive. The observed roughly215 Lv25 recommendations per hour is a declared strategy throughput, not an income ceiling; shallow training can recommend more frequently. First-hour948/996 actual coupons include57/62 phase firsts and must not be extrapolated as mature steady-state income.
The per-template seen list is minimal gameplay data. Storage recovery, backup tooling and unrelated systems remain deferred at the user request.

Economy11 corrects the unrequested gym8-only condition: all gym levels count successful final-template recommendations from gym1; first normal, repeats1, unmatched0, upgrades never reset. Historical real final-template alumni and the old list are merged once atomically; collection/appearance are not counted and cash is preserved.

Selected admission is8 coupons in economy11 with unchanged directional base46..48 and ordinary growth. Repeated-template selected admission has7 net cost. It improves birth stats and modestly raises high-tier frequency in controlled samples; it does not guarantee extra unique collection.

Current deep-training construction completed4/4 within19.64..41.60 continuous-online hours; the paired25-turnover policy completed both tested seeds in3.385/4.667 hours. Strategy differences are not code changes or casual calendar-time promises. Each actually paid1237 coupons with no injected cash/templates or post-settlement adjustment.

Two tested25-turnover full-build one-hour free flows added364/329 coupons and7/6 new collection entries; mixed8-coupon flows spent336/280 and added4/5 new entries. Sequential recruit RNG diverges; small samples and finite first rewards do not establish steady hourly income or universal collection superiority.
V11 preserves all equipment/project effects and prices, adds active-equipment warehousing and on-demand current-player25/99 time comparisons; no template target recommendation module is reintroduced.
